about: Researched reservation info (key = OSM ref, or id:<id> for curated records in <city>.json). Written by scripts/merge_reservations.py; import_osm.py re-applies the OSM entries after each import. An existing reservation_url / phone is never overwritten.

id:arbane.name: Arbane
id:arbane.note: Zenchef page loads (HTTP 200); embedded data shows 'Restaurant Arbane - Gent', Wijzemanstraat 4. The own site still links rid=369935.

id:arno-ristorante.name: ARNO ristorante
id:arno-ristorante.note: Own site down when checked 23/10 (homepage: 'Please stand by while configuration is in progress', /contact/ gives HTTP 500), so no booking button could be checked. Search-indexed copy of the contact page lists reservations@arnoristorante.be and T +32 092120121; Michelin Guide (https://guide.michelin.com/be/nl/oost-vlaanderen/gent/restaurant/arno-ristorante) says the restaurant manages its own bookings. Likely email/phone, but the live site does not confirm it. Recheck when the site is back.

id:commotie.name: Commotie
id:commotie.note: Own 'Reservations - Commotie' page loads with an embedded TableFever widget (v3, restoHashId 9xga0). The public TableFever page for 9xga0 returns 404, so keep the own page as the link.

id:dapper.name: Dapper.
id:dapper.note: Zenchef page loads; data shows 'DAPPER.', Gent, Planet Group Arena (= Ottergemsesteenweg Zuid 808). The own site still links rid=377604.

id:karel-de-stoute.name: Karel de Stoute
id:karel-de-stoute.note: /reserveren now redirects to the homepage. The homepage embeds a TableFever widget (restoHashId dgak0) whose page is titled 'Karel de stoute | TableFever'.

id:lof.name: LOF
id:lof.note: Homepage "RESERVE NOW" opens the Guestplan widget; the homepage is used as the link (the direct widget URL could not be confirmed).

id:lys-d-or.name: Lys d'Or
id:lys-d-or.note: Site is 'Powered by TableFever' ('Reserveer uw tafel eenvoudig met TableFever'); reservationUrl in page script resolves to the TableFever page titled 'Lys d'Or | TableFever' at Charles de Kerchovelaan 81.

id:moscou-by-danny-horseele.name: Moscou by Danny Horseele
id:moscou-by-danny-horseele.note: The 'Reserveren' menu item goes to an Odoo booking page ('Reserveer Restaurant Moscou Gentbrugge', with date & time and details steps). Only https://www. works; the bare domain doesn't answer from the box.

id:oak.name: OAK
id:oak.note: Own page loads. It has two systems: 'reservaties tot 30/12/2026' uses the Tock widget (tock init 'oak'), 'reservaties vanaf 2027' uses Platemate (app.platemate.be). Keep the own page because the provider switches at the new year. exploretock.com/oak sits behind a Cloudflare challenge from the box, so it wasn't verified.

id:publiek.name: Publiek
id:publiek.note: Zenchef page loads; data shows 'Publiek', Ham 39, Gent. The own site's /nl/reserveren embeds data-restaurant=381344.

id:rizoom.name: Rizoom
id:rizoom.note: Own page loads with an embedded TableFever widget (9GyvY → 'Rizoom | TableFever'). The page says reservations open on the 1st of each month for 2 months ahead. bookingUrl is an optional direct provider link; the existing one is fine.

id:sakas.name: Sākas
id:sakas.note: Zenchef page loads; data shows Lammerstraat 13, Gent, omakase offers. The own site still links rid=369609.

id:sensum.name: Sensum
id:sensum.note: Redirects to the /nl/…?step=date booking wizard titled 'Sensum' (an expected redirect, not a problem). The own site still links this widget. The widget says same-day bookings and groups of 8+ go by phone (+32 9 246 11 46).

id:talloor-d-or.name: Talloor d'Or
id:talloor-d-or.note: Own 'Reservatie' page loads and embeds the Tallores booking widget (widget.tallores.com, restaurantId mdzun56kt5z6w2). There is no separate provider page.

id:vrijmoed.name: Vrijmoed
id:vrijmoed.note: Own page loads with a TableFever widget trigger (9xrwm → 'Vrijmoed | TableFever'); the page also mentions booking by phone. bookingUrl is an optional direct provider link.
